notes.title: Developer update
notes.content:
Since we announced Neverdark we have been surprised by the amount of interest around the project. We were thrilled to see so many of you anticipating the game.

During the testing phase of some extremely important gameplay mechanics, though, we noticed that some things were not quite working yet.

Therefore we have taken the decision to allocate more resources and more time for development so we can go back to the re-design phase and tweak certain core gameplay mechanics. We are currently deep in the re-design phase, and this means we are not quite ready to reveal when Neverdark will be released.
We are committed to making Neverdark the best game it can be: the team is working extremely hard right now, and we hope we’ll be able to deliver more news in the coming months.

notes.title: Come and meet the devs!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34637734/f57fc48becd2e1c8c97da86eefde2dfacf6bfa4c.jpg[/img]

Last week we announced an exciting upcoming new game, [b]Neverdark[/b].

Set in a world where modern society was destroyed by a global blackout, you will lead a group of survivors set on securing and shaping a new urban community.

The urban context is king in Neverdark. In fact you play in real maps of real cities, and you will be able to occupy and re-purpose real buildings, including famous ones. The game will have three different maps at release: Paris, Tokyo and New York.

When we announced the game during Home of Wargamers Live last Monday we spoke at length of its gameplay. In case you missed it, you can re-watch it now on our YouTube channel.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=koWx-Kh9OVw

Simteract, the developers of Neverdark, have a busy schedule ahead of them: they will be attending to several shows in the next two weeks.

If you are in San Francisco or Boston, it will be your chance to meet them and even have a look at an alpha version of Neverdark!

Come and meet them at:

- [b]The MIX[/b], San Francisco, 18.03
-[b] GDC[/b], San Francisco, 20-22.03
- [b]PAX East[/b], Boston, 28-31.03

See you there!
